verification: Static source and test inspection; no build or test execution by this reviewer. No workspace source edits.
scope: Only seven new food source/test files and their existing directly reused domain/TagInput source; not a persistence, import, canonical-admission, native-platform or release gate.
privacy: No private food import, whitelist payload, profile or live data access; reviewed fixture strings are synthetic. This is bounded source inspection, not a repository-wide secret certification.
observations: No dart:io, profile, storage, transport, database or model adapter is imported or called by the new preview files. Main starts only FoodPreviewApp; fixed synthetic examples are stored in process-local lists.
Closed keys and action-specific payload validation; canonical container IDs and safe operation reference sequence; target count <=100, reference count <=1000, strings and rational contents bounded.

Conflicting repeated operation IDs reject; replay sorts deterministically; known reference wrong kind, wrong container and noncausal clock reject even without target creation; pre-creation mutations reject when the creation is known.

Restore removes only observed deletion IDs. New/unobserved deletions survive. Contents alternatives remain visible until observed resolution; equivalent rational values collapse in conflict comparison.

Dialog callbacks capture container IDs/observed edit state, use single-answer/current-route checks, and avoid mutation on Cancel. Edit emits changed fields only; Add validates before callback, checks active composition and count1..100. Group removal is batched <=100. Text is rendered as Flutter Text, with no evaluation, rich HTML or path use.

deferred_production_gates.issue: order accepts positive values beyond 9007199254740991; constructor has no upper ceiling and wire permits up to19 digits. Define bounded safe clock and exact wire representation before persisted cross-platform replay.
deferred_production_gates.example: valid add operation with order=9007199254740992 validates on native Dart; this receipt does not execute that example.

deferred_production_gates.issue: Missing referenced operations are allowed and their effects/observed IDs are projected immediately; later known wrong references throw. Before untrusted canonical admission provide explicit pending status, no authoritative partial projection/checkpoint, and transactional late-validation/rollback.

No total record-byte, delivered-operation, container or graph budget. Local synthetic preview is bounded only by generated commands, not safe for untrusted history/import. Reject oversized lists before conversion and count expansion; measure wide fanout/duplicate/replay CPU before adoption.

Local sequence/order generator and list mutation are preview-only, with no module/space/writer chain proof, reserved receipt or append uncertainty. Implement reviewed food namespace/guards and exact prepared retries separately; do not copy these callbacks into durable storage.

Dialogs retain captured callbacks and check mounted after await, but do not recheck a later busy/session state; 250ms disposal delay is a preview assumption rather than route-lease completion. Durable host must serialize/revalidate accepted intents and await actual route/session cleanup. Group Restore currently invokes one callback per container; no durable all-or-nothing promise.
